summary: This note describes EDP Renováveis (EDPR), a renewable energy company established in 2007 to hold and operate the renewable energy assets of its parent, Energias de Portugal (EDP Group). The parent is described as Portugal's largest utility, headquartered in Lisbon. The note states that EDPR is the fourth-largest wind energy generator in the world.
one_line: EDP Renováveis, founded in 2007 as the renewables arm of Portugal's EDP Group, is the world's fourth-largest wind energy generator.
key_facts: EDPR was established to hold and operate the growing renewable energy assets of its parent company, Energias de Portugal (EDP Group).
Energias de Portugal (EDP Group) is described as Portugal's largest utility company.
Energias de Portugal (EDP Group) is headquartered in Lisbon.
EDP Renováveis is the fourth-largest generator of wind energy globally.
